About

A Life Composed in Sound

Having studied Arts, Mousumi Chatterjee embarked on her creative journey with a deep-rooted passion for art, culture, and, above all, music. Her love for music began in childhood — while children of her age were learning to sing, she was already exploring her own compositions and experimenting with melodies.

For Mousumi, music exists everywhere: in the sounds of nature, in everyday life, and in the world around her. This perspective has enriched her creative imagination and encouraged her to think beyond conventional boundaries. She also holds a keen interest in Bengali literature and cinema, and her naturally curious personality constantly inspires her to explore new ideas, stories, and forms of artistic expression.

As a young music director, Mousumi has been associated with the music industry for nearly a decade. With an honest intention to create meaningful and lasting impressions through her work, she ventured into independent music production at a young age — since then producing several music albums and working across short films, documentaries, ad films, corporate films, and web series.

“Mullick Bari” marked her debut as a music director for a feature film. She subsequently composed music for “O Abhagi,” “Khancha,” “Kashimnagar,” “Vowel,” and “Ultorath.” With her distinctive musical sensibility and passion for storytelling through sound, she continues to explore new dimensions of music and craft her own identity in Indian cinema.
